title.narrative: 2005 Convention - Strengthening Cultural and Creative Industries in East Asia

description.narrative:
This project aims to strengthen the capacities of young people in East Asia and support their meaningful participation in the cultural and creative industries. Through targeted training, knowledge exchange, and skills development opportunities, the project will equip young cultural practitioners, artists, and creative entrepreneurs with the competencies needed to navigate an evolving cultural and creative economy. Particular emphasis will be placed on fostering innovation, collaboration, and the ability to respond to emerging social, technological, and environmental challenges.
The project will also create opportunities for networking and regional exchange, enabling young people to connect with peers, mentors, institutions, and industry stakeholders across East Asia. By strengthening professional networks and encouraging cross-border collaboration, the initiative will contribute to a more inclusive and dynamic cultural and creative industries ecosystem. In doing so, it will support young people's role not only as beneficiaries of cultural development, but also as active contributors to cultural vitality, economic growth, and sustainable development at both national and regional levels.
